events.preview_text: Queue routine posts, then move a timely local update to the front.
events.body:
Plan several social posts ahead in Buffer, then move a timely local update to the front when it matters.

Buffer is a social scheduling tool with a queue you can rearrange as priorities change. Add the routine posts you want ready for the week, then reschedule them when something more immediate deserves the next spot.

On the Free plan, you can connect **up to 3 channels** and hold **up to 10 scheduled posts per channel**. After a post publishes, that slot opens again.

Before trying a one-week queue, check the official plan page to decide whether those limits fit your posting rhythm.

Review plans and pricing

- the Buffer team

Before trying one weekly queue, review the official Free plan and decide whether those limits fit your posting rhythm.

events.subject: Plan posts, keep local updates flexible
events.preview_text: Queue the week, then move a timely update forward when needed.
events.body:
Plan several social posts ahead while keeping their order flexible. Buffer is a social media scheduling tool with a visible queue you can rearrange as the week changes.

Add the week’s planned posts to the queue. If changed opening hours need an earlier spot, reschedule that update by dragging it ahead of the other posts.

On the Free plan, you can connect **up to three channels** and schedule **10 posts per channel**.

Before trying a weekly queue, check the official Free plan against the channels you use and the number of posts you want lined up. You’ll know whether its limits fit your week.
